nina_s: quick FYI - saw a tenant preview spike where nearline shows ~1.9M tokens but ledger 940k. Suspect shadowed duplicates + minute-level clock skew.
maya_ops: can you paste the tiny log snippet?
nina_s: 
2026-03-26T11:59:59.995Z nearline tenant=t-9 fp=fpX event=e-91 tokens=600
2026-03-26T12:00:00.005Z nearline tenant=t-9 fp=fpX|shadow event=e-91 tokens=600
Preview aggregates on fp||tenant||hour so both counted. Ledger dedupes on event id so invoices fine.
raj_platform: options: strip shadow tags in preview normalizer (cheap), add ?include_shadow flag (UI toggle), or upsert-by-event in nearline (heavier).
sara_billing: billing wants preview_meta.sources_included and an API param include_shadow=false so support can show the de-noised view. Also a console banner: "Preview may include transient shadowed rows; final invoice unaffected."
maya_ops: rollout plan: 1) add preview_meta + include_shadow toggle today; 2) enable strip-shadow normalizer behind flag next week; 3) evaluate upsert-by-event if noise persists. Gate heavy work behind canary tenants.
ops-bot: [automated] Created BP-4501: "preview shadow normalization + include_shadow API" assigned to maya_ops, raj_platform.
raj_platform: adding telemetry metrics preview_shadow_tokens and preview_de_dup_rate. Pager if shadow_tokens > 20% for top-20 tenants.
nina_s: thanks. Support and billing will prep comms and UI note. We should sample shadowed forwards at 10% during canary to limit nearline load.
sara_billing: ack, will prepare support blurb and include preview_meta in tenant API responses.
